# vep-rs 0.3.1

vep-rs 0.3.1 carries exact adjusted concordance with Ensembl VEP 115.2 from the chromosome 21 measurement to the whole genome: on gnomAD v4.1, gnomAD v2.1.1, 1000 Genomes Phase 3 and 1000 Genomes high-coverage, 1,179,639,224 variants and 9,281,654,995 annotation tuples, every tuple outside the documented divergence classes is matched, after four consequence rules at the edges of the coding region and the coordinates of a symbolic insertion were brought to Ensembl VEP's reading; anyone annotating whole-genome call sets, and anyone annotating symbolic insertions, should upgrade.

## Upgrade notes

- Consequence terms move on the records the changelog's Fixed entries name: an insertion between an intron's last base and the coding region's edge base is a UTR variant beside its splice term; a variant in a frameshift intron on the UTR side of the coding region takes the UTR term instead of `coding_sequence_variant`; structural `stop_lost` requires the deletion to overlap the coding region and an exon; a structural span starting on the first base of a transcript whose coding region starts there carries no 5' UTR term.
- A symbolic insertion whose `END` is its position or whose `SVLEN` is 0 (the `<INS:MT>` and `<INS:ME:*>` records of 1000 Genomes Phase 3 and call sets of that shape) is the insertion between two bases: its Location names both flanks (`11:7309883-7309884`, where 0.3.0 wrote `11:7309884`), its row carries no `OverlapBP` or `OverlapPC`, and its consequence terms read the pair. Tooling keyed on the Location column of such rows sees the new form.
- Flags, input formats, output formats and the JSON cache format are unchanged; a cache converted for 0.3.0 is valid.
